fields.name: P1
fields.title: Heat-flow value
fields.description: Heat-flow density (q) for the location after all corrections for instrumental and environmental effects.

fields.name: P2
fields.title: Heat-flow uncertainty
fields.description: Uncertainty (one standard deviation) of the heat-flow value [q] estimated by an error propagation from uncertainty in thermal conductivity and temperature gradient, standard deviation from the average of the heat flow intervals or deviation from the linear regression of the Bullard plot

fields.name: P3
fields.title: Site name
fields.description: Specification of the (local) name of the related heat-flow site or the related survey. Should be consistent with the publication.

fields.name: P4
fields.title: Geographical latitude
fields.description: Latitude (lat) is a geographic coordinate that specifies the North–South (NS) position of a point on the planetary's surface. The Equator has a latitude of 0°, the North Pole has a latitude of 90° North (written +90), and the South Pole has a latitude of 90° South (written −90). Numeric values (2 digits) with 5 decimal places are used for this database item instead of the N or S format (e.g., -80.00000 instead of 80° S).

fields.name: P5
fields.title: Geographical longitude
fields.description: Longitude (long) is a geographic coordinate that specifies the east–west (EW) position of a point on the planetary surface. The Prime Meridian, which passes near the Royal Observatory, Greenwich, England, is defined as 0° longitude by convention. Positive longitudes are east of the Prime Meridian, and negative ones are west. Numeric values (3 digits) with 5 decimal places are used for this database instead of the E or W format (e.g., -50.00000 instead of 50° W).

fields.name: P6
fields.title: Elevation (Geographical)
fields.description: The elevation of a geographic location is its height above (land elevation) or below (water depth) mean sea level. Caution: different national reference systems are used. Also the reference level may be diverse depending on the study (drilling, lake, marine…).

fields.name: P7
fields.title: Basic geographical environment
fields.description: Describes the general geographical setting of the heat-flow site (not the applied methodology).

fields.name: P8
fields.title: General comments parent level
fields.description: Comments on the reported heat-flow location value.

fields.name: P9
fields.title: Flag heat production of the overburden (heat-flow correction)
fields.description: Specifies if corrections to the calculated heat flow considers the contribution of the heat production of the overburden to the terrestrial surface heat flow q.

fields.name: P10
fields.title: Total Measured Depth
fields.description: Specification of the total measured depth below mean sea level. Caution: different national reference systems are used. Also the reference level may be diverse depending on the study (drilling, lake, marine…).

fields.name: P11
fields.title: Total True Vertical Depth
fields.description: Specification of the total true vertical depth below mean sea level. Caution: different national reference systems are used. Also the reference level may be diverse depending on the study (drilling, lake, marine…).

fields.name: P12
fields.title: Type of exploration method
fields.description: Specification of the general means by which the rock was accessed by temperature sensors for the respective data entry.

fields.name: P13
fields.title: Original exploration purpose
fields.description: Main purpose of the reconnaissance target providing access for the temperature sensors.

fields.name: C1
fields.title: Heat-flow value child
fields.description: Any kind of heat-flow value (qc).

fields.name: C2
fields.title: Heat-flow uncertainty child
fields.description: Uncertainty (one standard deviation) of the heat-flow value [qc] estimated by an error propagation from uncertainty in thermal conductivity and temperature gradient or deviation from the linear regression of the Bullard plot (corrected preferred over measured gradient).

fields.name: C3
fields.title: Heat-flow method
fields.description: Principal method of heat-flow calculation from temperature and thermal conductivity data. Allowed entries: controlled vocabulary

fields.name: C4
fields.title: Heat-flow interval top
fields.description: Describes the true vertical depth (TVD) of the top end of the heat-flow determination interval relative to the land surface/seafloor.

fields.name: C5
fields.title: Heat-flow interval bottom
fields.description: Describes the true vertical depth (TVD) of the bottom end of the heat-flow determination interval relative to the land surface.

fields.name: C6
fields.title: Penetration depth
fields.description: Penetration depth of marine probe into the sediment.

fields.name: C7
fields.title: Primary publication reference
fields.description: References of primary publication related to the respective heat-flow entry.
fields.guidance: Write the reference in the form [First author_Year_Title_Journal/ Publisher_doi].

fields.name: C8
fields.title: Primary reference
fields.description: References of primary data publication related to the respective heat-flow entry.
fields.guidance: Write the reference in the form [First author_Year_Title_Journal/ Publisher_doi].

fields.name: C9
fields.title: Relevant child
fields.description: Specifies whether the child entry is used for computation of representative location heat-flow values at the parent level or not.

fields.name: C10
fields.title: General comments child level
fields.description: Comments and further specifications to the individual reported heat-flow determination.

fields.name: C11
fields.title: Flag in-situ thermal properties
fields.description: Specifies whether the in-situ pressure and temperature conditions were considered to the reported thermal conductivity value or not.

fields.name: C12
fields.title: Flag temperature corrections (instrumental correction)
fields.description: Specifies if instrumental corrections to the measured temperature data were required and performed, e.g. for the tilt correction of probes.

fields.name: C13
fields.title: Flag sedimentation effect (temperature/heat flow correction)
fields.description: Specifies if sedimentation/subsidence effects with respect to the reported heat-flow value were present and if corrections were performed.

fields.name: C14
fields.title: Flag erosion effect (heat-flow correction)
fields.description: Specifies if erosion effects with respect to the reported heat-flow value were present and if corrections were performed.

fields.name: C15
fields.title: Flag topographic effect (heat-flow correction)
fields.description: Specifies if topographic effects with respect to the reported heat-flow value were present and if corrections were performed.

fields.name: C16
fields.title: Flag paleoclimatic effect (heat-flow correction)
fields.description: Specifies if climatic conditions (glaciation, post-industrial warming, etc.) with respect to the reported heat-flow value were present and if corrections were performed.

fields.name: C17
fields.title: Flag transient surface temperature (heat-flow correction)
fields.description: Specifies if surface temperature variation (S) or bottom water temperature variation (B) with respect to the reported heat-flow value were present and if corrections were performed.

fields.name: C18
fields.title: Flag convection processes (heat-flow correction)
fields.description: Specifies if convection effects with respect to the reported heat-flow value were present and if corrections were performed.

fields.name: C19
fields.title: Flag heat refraction effect (heat-flow correction)
fields.description: Specifies if refraction effects, e.g., due to significant local conductivity contrasts, with respect to the reported heat-flow value were present and if corrections were performed.

fields.name: C20
fields.title: Platform, Vessel, Expedition
fields.description: Specification of the expedition, cruise, platform or research vessel where the marine heat flow survey was conducted.
fields.guidance: Give the expedition cruise number, or the research vessel or drilling platform, in the forms [Expedition cruise number], [R/V Ship] and [D/V Platform].

fields.name: C21
fields.title: Probe type
fields.description: Type of heat-flow probe used for measurement.

fields.name: C22
fields.title: Probe length
fields.description: Length of marine heat-flow probe.

fields.name: C23
fields.title: Probe tilt
fields.description: Tilt of the marine heat-flow probe.

fields.name: C24
fields.title: Bottom-water temperature
fields.description: Seafloor temperature where surface heat-flow value (q) is taken. e.g. PT 100 or Mudline temperature for ocean drilling data.

fields.name: C25
fields.title: Lithology
fields.description: Dominant rock type/lithology within the interval of heat-flow determination.
fields.guidance: Use existing CGI simple lithology (http://resource.geosciml.org/classifier/cgi/lithology) scheme for naming the lithology.

fields.name: C26
fields.title: Stratigraphic age
fields.description: Stratigraphic age (series/epoch or stage/age) of the depth range involved in the reported heat-flow determination.
fields.guidance: Use the existing International Chronostratigraphic Chart of the International Commission on Stratigraphy (https://stratigraphy.org).

fields.name: C27
fields.title: Calculated or inferred temperature gradient
fields.description: Mean temperature gradient measured for the heat-flow determination interval.

fields.name: C28
fields.title: Temperature gradient uncertainty
fields.description: Uncertainty (one standard deviation) of mean measured temperature gradient [T_grad_mean] as estimated by an error propagation from the uncertainty in the top and bottom temperature determinations or deviation from the linear regression of the temperature-depth data.

fields.name: C29
fields.title: Mean temperature gradient corrected
fields.description: Mean temperature gradient corrected for borehole (drilling/mud circulation) and environmental effects (terrain effects/topography, sedimentation, erosion, magmatic intrusions, paleoclimate, etc.). Name the correction method in the corresponding item.

fields.name: C30
fields.title: Corrected temperature gradient uncertainty
fields.description: Uncertainty (one standard deviation) of mean corrected temperature gradient [T_grad_mean_cor] as estimated by an error propagation from the uncertainty in the top and bottom temperature determinations or deviation from the linear regression of the temperature depth data.

fields.name: C31
fields.title: Temperature method (top)
fields.description: Method used for temperature determination at the top of the heat-flow determination interval.

fields.name: C32
fields.title: Temperature method (bottom)
fields.description: Method used for temperature determination at the bottom of the heat-flow determination interval.

fields.name: C33
fields.title: Shut-in time (top)
fields.description: Time of measurement at the interval top in relation to the end values measured during the drilling are equal to zero.

fields.name: C34
fields.title: Shut-in time (bottom)
fields.description: Time of measurement at the interval bottom in relation to the end values measured during the drilling are equal to zero.

fields.name: C35
fields.title: T correction method (top)
fields.description: Applicable only if gradient correction for borehole effects is reported. Approach applied to correct the temperature measurement for drilling perturbations at the top of the interval used for heat-flow determination.

fields.name: C36
fields.title: T correction method (bottom)
fields.description: Applicable only if gradient correction for borehole effects is reported. Approach applied to correct the temperature measurement for drilling perturbations at the bottom of the interval used for heat-flow determination.

fields.name: C37
fields.title: Number of temperature recordings
fields.description: Number of discrete temperature points (e.g. number of used BHT values, log values or thermistors used in probe sensing) confirming the mean temperature gradient [T_grad_mean_meas]. Not the repetition of one measurement at a certain depth.

fields.name: C38
fields.title: Date of acquisition
fields.description: The entry gives the year of the acquisition of the temperature data (which may differ from the year of publication). If the month is unknown use 01, i.e. for the year 2005 use 2005-01. For non-unique time values, define a range in the format: ‘YYYY-MM; YYYY-MM’

fields.name: C39
fields.title: Mean thermal conductivity
fields.description: Mean conductivity in vertical direction representative for the interval of heat-flow determination. In best case, the value reflects the true in-situ conditions for the corresponding heat-flow interval.

fields.name: C40
fields.title: Thermal conductivity uncertainty
fields.description: Uncertainty (one standard deviation) of mean thermal conductivity [tc_mean]

fields.name: C41
fields.title: Thermal conductivity source
fields.description: Nature of the samples upon which thermal-conductivity was determined [tc_mean].

fields.name: C42
fields.title: Thermal conductivity location
fields.description: Location of conductivity data used for heat-flow calculation.

fields.name: C43
fields.title: Thermal conductivity method
fields.description: Method used for thermal-conductivity determination for [tc_mean].

fields.name: C44
fields.title: Thermal conductivity saturation
fields.description: Saturation state of the studied rock interval studied for thermal conductivity [tc_mean].

fields.name: C45
fields.title: Thermal conductivity pT conditions
fields.description: Qualified conditions of pressure and temperature under which the mean thermal conductivity [tc_mean] used for the heat-flow computation was determined.

fields.name: C46
fields.title: Thermal conductivity pT assumed function
fields.description: Technique or approach used to correct the measured thermal conductivity towards in-situ pressure (p) and/or temperature (T) conditions.

fields.name: C47
fields.title: TC number
fields.description: Number of discrete conductivity determinations used to determine the mean thermal conductivity [tc_mean], e.g. number of rock samples with a conductivity value used, or number of thermistors used by probe sensing techniques. Not the repetition of one measurement on one rock sample or one thermistor.

fields.name: C48
fields.title: Thermal conductivity averaging methodology
fields.description: Strategy that was employed to estimate the thermal conductivity [tc_mean] over the vertical interval of heat-flow determination.

fields.name: C49
fields.title: IGSN
fields.description: International Generic Sample Numbers (IGSN, semicolon separated) for rock samples used for laboratory measurements of thermal conductivity in the heat flow calculation.

fields.name: A1
fields.title: Reviewer_name
fields.description: The reviewer's name.

fields.name: A2
fields.title: Reviewer_comment
fields.description: The reviewer's comment.

fields.name: A3
fields.title: Review Date
fields.description: The date of the review.

fields.name: A4
fields.title: Country
fields.description: The country of the site.

fields.name: A5
fields.title: Region
fields.description: The region of the site.

fields.name: A6
fields.title: Continent
fields.description: The continent of the site.

fields.name: A7
fields.title: Domain
fields.description: The domain recorded in the review.

fields.name: A8
fields.title: Unique entry ID
fields.description: The unique ID of the child.
